instruction: Include the invoice file as an attachment in the email composition window. The invoice document is located at ~/aws-bill.pdf. Keep the email window open without sending or closing it.

metadata.explanation: Variation 0: Paraphrased instruction with same evaluator. Task requires attaching aws-bill.pdf to the email. Uses existing check_list metric with show-thunderbird-attachments.py script to verify attachment was added.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the main requirement: attachment was added to the email
Uses appropriate approach: external script to check Thunderbird's draft state for the attachment
Metric logic (check_list) correctly validates the success indicator pattern 'Attachment added!' in the output
Script accesses Thunderbird mail store/drafts, which is the correct approach since Thunderbird saves compose state automatically
The expected pattern matching is simple but appropriate for this binary verification (attachment present or not)
